    local prodIdAndValueList = callGridMethodByRowIdAndCol("","item4","getGridCellKeyAndValueArray","")
   local bcbfkcList = callGridMethodByRowIdAndCol("","inv","getLocalKeyAndValue","FPT_067_AT07")
   while true do
       local pos = string.find(prodIdAndValueList, "|")
       if (not pos) then
           break
       end
       local key_value = string.sub(prodIdAndValueList, 1, pos - 1)
       local position = string.find(key_value, ",")
       local key = string.sub(key_value, 1, position - 1)
       local value = string.sub(key_value, position + 1, string.len(key_value))
       local prodPos = string.find(key,"_")
        local prodId = string.sub(key,1,prodPos-1)
        local bcbfkc=""
        local tempBcbfkcList = bcbfkcList
        while true do
            local pos2 = string.find(tempBcbfkcList, "|");
            if (not pos2) then
                break
            end
            local key_value2 = string.sub(tempBcbfkcList, 1, pos2 - 1)
            local position2 = string.find(key_value2, ",")
            local key2 = string.sub(key_value2, 1, position2 - 1)
            local value2 = string.sub(key_value2, position2 + 1, string.len(key_value2))
            local prodPos2 = string.find(key2,"_")
            local prodId2 = string.sub(key2,1,prodPos2-1)
            if prodId == prodId2 then
                bcbfkc = value2;
                break
            end
            tempBcbfkcList = string.sub(tempBcbfkcList, pos2+1,#tempBcbfkcList);
        end
        if bcbfkc == "" or bcbfkc == "null" then
            bcbfkc = 0
        end
        if value == "null" or value == "" then
            value = 0
        end
         local jyddvalue = tonumber(value) - tonumber(bcbfkc)
         if jyddvalue < 0 then
           jyddvalue = 0
        end
        setTableColValueByProId(prodId, jyddvalue,"item2")
        prodIdAndValueList = string.sub(prodIdAndValueList, pos+1,#prodIdAndValueList)
    end
end

function tableDBDataFindProdValue(prodIdAndValueList,cellKey) 
    if prodIdAndValueList==nil or cellKey==nil then
        return "0";
    end
    s,e = string.find(prodIdAndValueList, cellKey..",");
    if (not s) then
        return "0";
    else
        s1,e1 = string.find(prodIdAndValueList, "@|",s);
        if (not s1) then
            return "0";
        else
            if tonumber(e+1) <= tonumber(e1-2) then
                local cellValue = string.sub(prodIdAndValueList, e+1, e1-2)
                if cellValue==nil or cellValue =="" or cellValue == "null" then
                    return "0";
                else
                    return cellValue
                end
            else
                return "0";
            end
        end
    end
end

funcs2.script:
function getAcvtData(storeId)
    local sql = "select serverAcvtData.acvt_qst_answer flag from base_store_acvt_dis serverAcvtData "..
            "join base_acvt_qst qst on serverAcvtData.acvtId = qst.acvtId and serverAcvtData.acvtQstId = qst._id and qst.qstCod = 'isReq' "..
            "where serverAcvtData.sid = '"..storeId.."' "
    local isHasOrangeFlag = getDataByMethod("executeSql:",sql)
    if isHasOrangeFlag~="" then
        sql = "select localAcvtData.acvt_qst_answer flag from visit_store_acvt_data localAcvtData "..
                "join base_acvt_qst qst on localAcvtData.acvtId = qst.acvtId and (localAcvtData.acvtQstId = qst.qsttype||qst.acvtQstId  or localAcvtData.acvtQstId = qst.acvtQstId ) and qst.qstCod = 'isReq' and qst.acvtid = '104104'"..
                "where localAcvtData.sid = '"..storeId.."'"
        local isHasVisited = getDataByMethod("executeSql:",sql)
        if isHasVisited=="" then
            setTip("请先完成付费陈列活动")
            return
        end
    end
    sql = "select serverAcvtData.acvt_qst_answer flag from base_store_acvt_dis serverAcvtData "..
            "join base_acvt_qst qst on serverAcvtData.acvtId = qst.acvtId and serverAcvtData.acvtQstId = qst._id and qst.qstCod = 'isReq2' "..
            "where serverAcvtData.sid = '"..storeId.."' "
    local isHasPayActivity = getDataByMethod("executeSql:",sql)
    if isHasPayActivity~="" then
        sql = "select localAcvtData.acvt_qst_answer flag from visit_store_acvt_data localAcvtData "..
                "join base_acvt_qst qst on localAcvtData.acvtId = qst.acvtId and (localAcvtData.acvtQstId = qst.qsttype||qst.acvtQstId  or localAcvtData.acvtQstId = qst.acvtQstId ) and qst.qstCod ='isReq2' "..
                "where localAcvtData.sid = '"..storeId.."'"
        local isHasVisited = getDataByMethod("executeSql:",sql)
        if isHasVisited=="" then
            setTip("请先完成促销活动")
        end
    end
end
